title: What is the Anthropic API?

body.text: The API is the gateway for
your app to call Claude directly
— build a chatbot, a document-summarization system, or AI features in a product. You pay for the tokens you actually use.

example: "An online store calls the API to have Claude answer customer questions from product data, 24 hours a day"

title: The structure of an API call

body.text: to the Messages API and get an answer back — pick the model for the job: Haiku is fast and cheap, Sonnet is balanced, Opus is the smartest.

example: "{ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-5', max_tokens: 1024, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize this text' }] }"
